answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a lone sparrow: present but carrying no proven mass. Standing deepens like an ocean, each attested contribution adding a layer until it hardens into crystal, slow to counterfeit. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure rather than key count, synthetic sparrows stay small while genuine contributors hold crystal clear standing.
